mapper.select:
SELECT -- 기본 유저 정보 u.user_code, u.id, u.create_signup, u.user_tell, -- 유저의 약관 동의 여부 불린값 utar.agreed, -- 약관 내용 tv.content, -- 결제 건 요약 paysummary.paycnt, -- 게시글 작성 요약 artworkWritingsummary.writingcnt FROM user AS u LEFT JOIN ( select * From user_terms_agree_record as s where s.terms_code = 1 and s.version_id = 1) as utar ON u.user_code = utar.user_code LEFT JOIN terms_version as tv
ON tv.terms_code = utar.terms_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS paycnt, oi.user_id FROM order_info AS oi WHERE oi.order_status_id = 3 GROUP BY oi.user_id) AS paysummary
ON paysummary.user_id = u.user_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS writingcnt, a.user_code FROM artworks AS a
GROUP BY a.user_code) AS artworkWritingsummary
ON artworkWritingsummary.user_code = u.user_code WHERE u.enabled=1;
